# Workaround test

`customer_support.pb.ticket_triage.workaround_test` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Ask whether a workaround the customer can execute today exists, before deciding severity.

It is the only severity input a triager can usually establish without engineering, and it genuinely changes the answer — the same fault with and without a clean workaround are not the same severity, because severity is about harm sustained rather than code correctness.
